schema.description: core component manifest. packs/<lang>/pack.json, adapters/<name>/adapter.json and adapters/optional-plugins/<name>/plugin.json use the same shape and may add a detect key.

entry.source: path relative to this component directory; a directory is expanded to every file below it
entry.target: path relative to ~/.claude; rules/refs/agents land as <category>/<name>.md, skills as skills/<name>/, hook scripts as hooks/aicj/, bin as bin/, templates as aicj/

hooks.event: Claude Code hook event, e.g. PreToolUse
hooks.matcher: hook matcher expression; empty string matches everything
hooks.script: installed script path relative to ~/.claude, must live under hooks/aicj/
hooks.blocking: true when the script consults AICJ_HOOK_MODE (warn by default, block under install --strict)

detect.files: glob list that enables the component when matched in the target project
detect.package_deps: package.json dependency names that enable the component
